scripts.build: yarn clean && node ./scripts/fetch-market-home-token-seed.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production rspack build && cp ./web-build/index.html ./web-build/404.html && bash ./postbuild.sh
scripts.build:webpack: yarn clean && node ./scripts/fetch-market-home-token-seed.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack build -c ./webpack.config.kill-switch.js && cp ./web-build/index.html ./web-build/404.html && bash ./postbuild.sh
scripts.build:lavamoat: yarn clean && node ./scripts/fetch-market-home-token-seed.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=10240 webpack build -c ./webpack.config.kill-switch.js && cp ./web-build/index.html ./web-build/404.html && bash ./postbuild.sh
scripts.lavamoat:policy: cross-env NODE_ENV=production ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT=1 ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT_GENERATE_POLICY=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=10240 webpack build -c ./webpack.config.kill-switch.js
